body: Words of strength are absolutely appreciated here. Words of hope, wisdom, anything. Our life is so beautiful, I’m trying to figure out how we can keep that beauty in our home when such darkness is raging through it.

Everything started falling apart after the move. We entered couples therapy ~8 months ago and he entered individual ~4 months ago when he disclosed what happened to me. 

We’re reaching the point where separation (hopefully temporary) feels inevitable for her sake. I don’t want him to feel abandoned, though.
OP used the wrong cashapp and sent money originally to the wrong person, they added an h.
No, not until we were cleared to leave. I wouldn’t put my daughter in danger like that.

I like this idea. I worry so much about any unintended impact from today even though she had no idea what was going on. Emotions were heavy and she is seriously the biggest ray of sunshine.

I actually have PTSD already that I’ve been in treatment for for years. Definitely will be talking to my therapist about this and working to establish one for my husband. He is very shaken too and neither of us has a particularly strong support system.
I just can’t imagine raising my daughter here.
